title: Online booking cancellation — blocked task plan
summary: The core cancellation path is traced; notification work stays blocked until the owner chooses a channel.

tasks.title: Cancellation eligibility and preview contract
tasks.objective: Expose deterministic eligibility and refund preview before cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Eligible bookings show the exact refund preview.
verification: Contract tests cover eligible and ineligible bookings.

tasks.title: Send cancellation confirmation
tasks.objective: Notify the traveller after cancellation commits.
acceptance_criteria: The chosen channel receives exactly one confirmation.
verification: The worker test asserts one message per accepted cancellation.

scope_expansion_requests.rationale: The approved packet explicitly excludes partial refunds, so this needs a new packet revision and approval.
